response.text: Several leads confirmed. Let me check the duplicate invoice details, the AP-to-GL tie-out, and the reversal.

arguments.sql: SELECT i."INV_ID", i."VEND_CD", i."INV_NO", i."INV_DT", i."INV_AMT", i."JRNL_NO", h."PRD_ID", h."POST_DT" FROM "APINVH" i LEFT JOIN "GLJRNH" h ON h."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" WHERE i."INV_ID" IN (249,801)

SELECT i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT", SUM(l."CR_AMT") AS cr_ap, SUM(l."DR_AMT") AS dr_ap FROM "APINVH" i JOIN "GLJRNL" l ON l."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" GROUP BY i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT" HAVING SUM(l."CR_AMT")<>ABS(i."INV_AMT") AND SUM(l."DR_AMT")<>ABS(i."INV_AMT") LIMIT 50

SELECT h."JRNL_NO", h."REF_JRNL_NO", l."ACCT_CD", l."DR_AMT", l."CR_AMT" FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLJRNL" l ON l."JRNL_NO" IN (2320,2471) AND l."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO" WHERE h."JRNL_NO" IN (2320,2471) OR h."REF_JRNL_NO"=2320 ORDER BY 1
